title: WorkBuddy
description: WorkBuddy from Tencent as a coding agent in Tomrade: conversations and tickets run on its CodeBuddy Code CLI, or the copy inside the WorkBuddy app, over ACP with Tomrade's tools, a ticket can also go to it in a terminal, its own sessions report to Tomrade once connected, and its sign-in answers Tomrade's background calls.

why.fs: Finds the CLI inside the WorkBuddy app, reads ~/.codebuddy (its MCP servers in .mcp.json, the model you last picked in settings.json, its logs for troubleshooting); a background call keeps its instructions in a temporary file.
why.exec: Runs your own `codebuddy` command, or the one inside the WorkBuddy app: its ACP server for conversations, `codebuddy --help` for its models, `codebuddy mcp add|remove` to connect it, and `codebuddy -p` for background calls.
